The '''Roost system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Bitrose sector/Legends|Bitrose sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], which contained the planet [[Roost (planet)|Roost]].
